hp_service_life_ground.source: Hubbuch & Vecsei, ZHAW Institut fuer Facility Management, 'Lebenszykluskosten von Waermepumpen' (for SIG Geneve), Weibull fit + Kaplan-Meier on Swiss owner survey
hp_service_life_ground.section: Tabelle 4.7: expected 26.7 +/- 0.8 yr, SD 4.7 +/- 0.6 yr, k = 7; N = 223
hp_service_life_ground.note: Borehole assumed 50 yr (SIA 384/6), so a unit replacement keeps the probe. value = expected life, lo/hi = +/- 1 SD of the life distribution. Read in the primary PDF and confirmed in notebook b02e42f0 (q15, source Bericht_LCC_EWS_2). The same report also gives expert opinion (air 18+/-3, ground 20+/-4) and its LCC baseline (air 16, ground 23); the survey fit is used because it rests on measured failures - sensitivity in P24.

hp_service_life_air.source: Hubbuch & Vecsei, ZHAW Institut fuer Facility Management, 'Lebenszykluskosten von Waermepumpen' (for SIG Geneve), Weibull fit + Kaplan-Meier on Swiss owner survey
hp_service_life_air.section: Tabelle 4.8: expected 20 +/- 2 yr, SD 7 +/- 2 yr, k = 3.0; N = 53 (43 from one firm)
hp_service_life_air.note: Authors: less reliable than ground-source. value = expected life, lo/hi = +/- 1 SD of the life distribution. Read in the primary PDF and confirmed in notebook b02e42f0 (q15, source Bericht_LCC_EWS_2).
